findings.current: “Long live His Majesty the Emperor! May His Highness the Crown Prince live ten thousand years!”
findings.defect: 황태제 is the emperor’s younger brother and designated heir, not his son; 천세 is a thousand years, not ten thousand.
findings.rationale: The two titles identify different heirs, and the acclamation deliberately gives them different numbers of years.
findings.replacement: “Long live His Majesty the Emperor! May His Highness the Imperial Crown Brother live a thousand years!”

findings.current: Every one of them had reached at least First Rate, with some attaining the Peak realm.
findings.defect: First Rate lowers the stated minimum from Supreme First Rate.
findings.rationale: 초일류 is the established Supreme First Rate realm, distinct from 일류.
findings.replacement: Every one of them had reached at least Supreme First Rate, with some attaining the Peak realm.
findings.source: 한 사람 한 사람이 최소 초일류에서 절정의 경지에 도달한

findings.current:
That was why the Blood-Sword Demon Lord had chosen Sima Gong as a partner, yet kept the last thread of suspicion alive right up until he set foot in Gansu.

Not until, based on the information Sima Gong had given him, they won a tremendous victory over the Kongtong Sect guarding Dunhuang.
findings.defect: The first sentence makes his suspicion end when he entered Gansu, although he retained it until the victory at Dunhuang.
findings.rationale: The Dunhuang victory, not his arrival in Gansu, dispelled his remaining suspicion.
findings.replacement:
That was why the Blood-Sword Demon Lord had chosen Sima Gong as a partner, but even when he set foot in Gansu, he still hadn’t let go of his last doubts.

Only after they won a tremendous victory over the Kongtong Sect guarding Dunhuang, using the information Sima Gong had given him, did he finally trust him.
findings.source:
그렇기에 거래의 대상으로 사마공을 택했으면서도, 감숙 땅에 발을 디딘 그 순간까지 마지막 의심을 끈을 놓지 않았었다.

그에게 전달받은 정보를 토대로, 돈황을 지키던 공동파를 상대로 엄청난 대승을 거두기 전까지는.

findings.current: “I’m no madman. I’m far too rational to do something insane like betray you twice. That’s why I joined hands with you.”
findings.defect: “Betray you twice” says Sima Gong has already betrayed Dark Heaven once. He means that turning on Dark Heaven now would make him a double traitor.
findings.rationale: 두 번 배신 counts betrayals of successive sides, not two betrayals of the same addressee.
findings.replacement: “I’m no madman. I’m too rational to betray one side only to turn on the other. That’s why I joined hands with you.”
findings.source: 나는 광인이 아니오. 이제 와서 두 번 배신하는 미친 짓을 벌이기에는 너무 이성적이지. 그렇기에 당신들과 손을 잡은 것이고.

findings.current: “But I’m immensely grateful. That crazy thing worked out, didn’t it?”
findings.defect: “Grateful” implies thanks to someone; Sima Gong expresses relief at his good fortune.
findings.rationale: 천만다행 marks a fortunate outcome, not gratitude.
findings.replacement: “But I’m incredibly lucky that moment of madness worked. Don’t you think?”
findings.source: 하지만 나로서는 천만다행이오. 그 미친 짓이 통했으니. 안 그렇소?

summary: Five actionable fidelity findings, including an incorrect royal identity and a lost realm distinction.
